description: Waits for the Builder sign-in started by `reclaim_authenticate` to finish, for up to timeoutSeconds (default 50, max 55). Returns status AUTHENTICATED (with expiresAt); PENDING (not finished yet: repeats signInUrl — call again, or remind the developer to open the link); FAILED (with reason: call `reclaim_authenticate` for a new link); or NOT_STARTED (no sign-in in progress and no valid session: call `reclaim_authenticate`).
name: wait_for_sign_in
